name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
one_liner: Salesforce Commerce Cloud is a cloud-based e‑commerce platform that provides RESTful APIs for storefronts, merchant tools, and integrations.
auth_notes: Shopper APIs use SLAS (OAuth 2.1) for authentication; Admin APIs use Account Manager.
access_notes: API credentials are issued by creating a SLAS client in the SLAS Admin UI or API, which requires the Account Administrator role in Account Manager.

evidence.snippet: The B2C Commerce API (SCAPI) is a set of RESTful APIs for building storefronts, merchant tools, and integrations on the B2C Commerce platform.
You can also create and store your client ID and secret in Account Manager.
Learn how to set up the Shopper Login and API Access Service (SLAS) so that you can request access tokens for Shopper APIs.

Use the B2C DX Model Context Protocol (MCP), which is part of the B2C Developer Toolkit, to enhance your development workflow by connecting an AI assistant, such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, to your B2C Commerce environment.

notes: The API is available at no extra cost for customers, but credentials require an Account Administrator role.
